on Wednesday said insider Jack Tobin will be promoted to Chief Financial Officer and will join the company's management team, effective March 2027.
Tobin has served as CME Group Chief Accounting Officer since 2015.
Earlier in June, CME said Lynne Fitzpatrick, currently president and chief financial officer, will be named chief executive officer of the company.
To ensure a smooth transition, Tobin will become deputy CFO in November 2026. Matthew Render will succeed Tobin as Chief Accounting Officer.

title: CME Group appoints Jack Tobin as CFO
